verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a heb' sacerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, mokab' k'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak yik manh chukok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley, wach'chom ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' jun chamnak chi'.
Anhej tato ha snun, ma smam, ma junok yuninal, ma junok yisil, ma junok yuktak,
ma junok yanab' heb' kob'es ayek' kajan yet'ok, ha schami, syal sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey jun chamnak chi'.
Palta max yal-laj sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak sk'ab' yok ix yetb'eyum heb'.
Mokab' sjoxel xil sjolom heb', mokab' sjoxpaxel xil sti' heb', mokab' yak'pax echnaj sniwanil heb' yuj schamel junok anima.

Palta wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb' yujto wiknhej yaj heb'. Mokab' chukok hin b'inaj yuj heb', yujto ha heb' snhusantz'a silab', syak'an ixim pan heb' ofrenda'il t'ayin, yuj chi' yowalil wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb'.
Max yalpaxlaj yik'an junok ix ajmul ix heb', ma junok ix ix ayxo winak ix ek' t'ay, ma junok ix ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Ch'okokab' yel heb' t'a yol he sat, yujto ha heb' tz'ak'anoch ixim pan ofrenda'il t'a wichanh, yujto ha hin Jehová hin wach' hinnhej, ha hin ix hin sik'kanel heb' yik wach' tz'ajkan heb'.
Tato ay junok heb' ix yisil junok heb' sacerdote chi' tz'och t'a ajmul ixal, syak' k'ixwelal smam ix chi', yowalil snhusjitz'a ix.

Ha winh sat sacerdote ix ik'jik'echa'anh t'a skal heb' yuktak ayik ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom, ayik ix ak'chajoch spichul winh te niwan yelk'ochi, max yal-laj toxonhej sb'at tzikan xil sjolom winh, max yalpaxlaj snhik'anb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Max yalpaxlaj sk'och winh b'aj ayek' junok chamnak, wach'chom smam, ma snun yik max yixtejb'at sb'a winh.

Ha yuj schamel heb' chi' max yal-laj yel winh t'a hin kajnub', max yalpaxlaj to syixtejb'at hin kajnub' chi' winh, yujto ix ak'ji'och aceite t'a winh yik sik'chajkaneli, yik tz'ochkan wikok. Ha hin Jehová hin swala'.
Ha winh sat sacerdote, ha junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak tz'ek' t'ay, ha ix syik' winh.

Max yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh yet' junok ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix ayxo winak tz'ek' t'ay, ma yet' junok ix ajmul ix. Palta yowalil ha junok ix kob'es ix syik' winh, junok ix yetchonhab' winh,
yik manh malajok tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuninal winh t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto ha hin Jehová hin ix hin sik'kanel winh, xchi Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón: Tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winh ay palta t'a sniwanil ol yal yak'an yofrenda heb' yetchonhab' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' yel wal malaj junok ay spalta'il sniwanil chi' ol yal yoch t'a jun opisio chi': Haton heb' max yal yilani, heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' palta snhi' ma schikin, heb' k'ichajnak xub' ma sk'ab', heb' nhojanemi sb'eyi, heb' tzapan ste'el yujto nenetak yok heb' yet' sk'ab', heb' ayoch ya'ax t'a yol sat, heb' aykan sjech'al junok yab'il t'ay, heb' ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil yet' heb' mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en.
Malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ay palta t'a sniwanil syal yoch t'a wichanh yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a'ok. Tato ay palta t'a sniwanil chi', max yal-laj yak'an ofrenda t'ayin.
Syal swa'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' heb' yet' masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaji,

palta max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a hin kajnub', ma sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey altar, yik max yixtejb'at hin kajnub' chi' heb', yujto ha hin Jehová hin, wik yaj juntzanh tastak chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil juntzanh tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yet' t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal.
